mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.phone, u.gender, u.role, u.status, u.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE(doc.cnt, 0) AS noteCount, COALESCE(kb.cnt, 0) AS kbCount FROM user u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT creator_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM document WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY creator_id ) doc ON u.id = doc.creator_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT creator_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_base WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY creator_id ) kb ON u.id = kb.creator_id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document WHERE creator_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_base WHERE creator_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{userId}
